subject: Runtime capacity: hiring package, comp-band uplift, and approval timeline
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runtime capacity: hiring package, comp-band uplift, and approval timeline

Team —

Quick ask: we need approvals for the Q4 runtime/infra slate so we can extend offers the week of Sep 22. Summary below and I'm attaching the HC request workbook + candidate packet for Jeremy Taylor (senior runtime).

Proposal (headcount + ask):
- Senior Runtime Engineer: 2 FTEs (requesting comp-band uplift from L4 -> L5 for market parity)
- Kernel SRE: 1 FTE (L4)
- Platform Capacity Manager: 1 FTE (L3)

Rationale: backlog on low-latency kernels and client-facing throughput features is delaying several product rollouts; two of these roles are mission-critical to hit October capacity targets. The market for senior runtime engineers is tight — the two candidates we have (Jeremy and an internal referral) require L5 banding to be competitive. Finance has provisionally OK'd the incremental spend if we get exec signoff by Sep 18.

Requests:
1) Approve headcount and band uplift for the two Senior Runtime hires (if you prefer one uplift + one L4 hire, note that as an alternative)
2) Approval to send offer to Jeremy (attached candidate packet) by Sep 22
3) If approved, I will coordinate with Norma at Greenfield for background checks and sign-off with HR.

Attachments: hc_request_q4_v2.xlsx, candidate_packet_JTaylor.pdf, comp-band-memo-sep2025.docx

Thanks — please reply with thumbs-up or questions so I can lock this into the hiring calendar.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Director, Runtime Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime capacity: hiring package, comp-band uplift, and approval timeline

Diego —

Thanks for the clear ask and the packet. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I sign off:

1) What is the incremental OPEX impact over 12 months for the two L5 vs two L4 hires? Please update the HC workbook with the delta and the funding source (central hiring budget vs infra ops).
2) Is there a compelling reason both hires must be L5? Can we make one priority L5 and keep the second as L4 with a strong comp package (signing bonus) instead?

If finance confirms the delta comes from the Q4 hiring envelope and you can provide the updated numbers by EOD Sep 15, I can greenlight the headcount and one band uplift.

-Kimberly
VP, People Operations
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime capacity: hiring package, comp-band uplift, and approval timeline

Kimberly / Diego —

I'm supportive of the slate and agree with prioritizing the two senior runtime hires. Operational note: given the timing, I'd prefer we convert one seat to a 6-month contractor-to-hire with a clause to convert earlier if the kernel work shows immediate impact. That buys us flexibility on comp while keeping momentum.

My asks:
- Please add the contractor-to-hire option to the HC workbook with expected 6-month cost and conversion scenarios
- If Jeremy is firm on L5 and won't accept the contractor route, proceed with direct offer (I trust Diego's read here).

Approving headcount pending Kimberly's ok on funding allocation.

—Marcus
Head of Platform Engineering
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime capacity: hiring package, comp-band uplift, and approval timeline

Diego / team —

Checked the candidate packet and talked to recruitment — Jeremy looks strong and could accelerate the KV cache and batching work. I'm okay with 1x L5 + 1x L4 + 1 contractor-to-hire as Marcus suggested, provided the L4 is backfilled from the internal referral pipeline and we earmark the second slot for the Dedicated Runtime backlog if capacity shifts.

Please include:
- Suggested interview loop (eng + kernel + product) in the Drive doc
- Proposed start window (target Oct 20 for first start)

Marissa
Director, Platform Programs
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime capacity: hiring package, comp-band uplift, and approval timeline

Team —

Thanks for the thread and the updated asks. I reviewed the HC workbook and comp memo. Finance confirmed the incremental headcount spend can be absorbed in Q4 under the platform hiring corridor provided Diego's team takes the contractor-to-hire route for one seat.

Final decisions:
- Approve 4 total seats (2 Senior Runtime, 1 Kernel SRE, 1 Platform Capacity Manager)
- Approve 1 L5 uplift (priority candidate Jeremy Taylor). The second senior role will be hired as L4 with a $12k sign-on and strong performance review at 6 months for potential rebanding.
- Approve contractor-to-hire as Marcus outlined for one seat (6-month term)
- HR may proceed to extend offers to Jeremy (L5) and start recruiter outreach for the L4 and Kernel SRE.

Diego — please confirm you have what you need to put the offer on the schedule and loop in Norma for the background check + start coordination.

—Irene
VP, Engineering Operations

On Tue, 16 Sep 2025 at 12:02 Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks all — confirming: I'll send the L5 offer to Jeremy today and update the HC workbook with the contractor scenario and the sign-on delta. 
> 
> Forwarding to Norma for next steps.
> 
> — Diego
